notes: RxRx1, 1139 classes, second independent pool: convnext_atto only (weight statistics comparable within the pool), checking the seed_1 efficientnet results on another backbone family. The optimisation ranges were corrected after the first seven draws under the earlier ranges: six sat at the loss of an untrained model, log(1139) = 7.04, and the only one that learned had lr 1.6e-4 and was still improving at epoch 15. Hence lr 3e-5 to 2.5e-4 instead of 1e-4 to 1e-3, AdamW only (one failure was Adam with weight decay 1e-2, an L2 penalty far too large for Adam), 20 to 40 epochs, and abandon_patience 8. Everything else matches configs/pools/rxrx1.json, and these convnext_atto ranges equal its case in rxrx1_mixed.json. Run with --pool-seed 2 --out pools/rxrx1_convnext_atto_seed_2, after --preflight. Frozen into the pool when it starts.
